name: ensemble_v20
information: v20e = v19 (unchanged, validated) + the entries below. Against v19e the entries at station 3127 (five event days) and 3128 (two festival days) are now sized and timed from the hourly bus boardings of the stops next to the venues on those very days (allowed: bus usage; no subway ridership of the evaluation period is read), converted with ratios measured on the training period. No leaderboard score is read or stored.

extras.name: SSG 랜더스페셜 매치 '최광야구 1429' (17:30~20:23 + 시상식·불꽃놀이)

scenarios.note: shares as at the bus stop

extras.basis: Bus boardings 154 / 360 / 15 at 20 / 21 / 22h: three tenths leave after the game, seven tenths after the fireworks.  Total 520 above background -> about 6,400 by subway (the attendance relation gives 6,300).  Bus boardings at the stop 문학경기장(야구장) (ARS 37144) on the day, background removed; subway boardings of the leaving crowd = bus x 11.9 (eight event days of the training period: 8.3-12.9, rising with size); bus taps come a few minutes later than subway taps, so 0.10-0.20 of the crowd is moved from the later to the earlier hour in one of the two scenarios.

extras.name: 2026 이슬라이브 페스티벌, 송도달빛축제공원 (14:00~21:30)

scenarios.note: ends 21:30 as on the ticket page: more than half of the leaving crowd in the 21h cell
crowd leaves as at the festivals that close at 22:00: forecast kept

extras.basis: The retrained model answers the festival flag at this station with the profile of the festivals that close at 22:00 (beer festival, Pentaport): about 600 / 1,290 / 340 boardings at 21 / 22 / 23h.  The ticket page gives 14:00 start and 450 minutes, i.e. an end at 21:30.  The entry keeps the size of the crowd and moves part of it to the 21h cell.  Split of the leaving crowd between hour cells: outputs/ensemble_v15/external/exit_split_by_end_minute.csv (home games of the training period: an end before :40 puts 79-95 % into the hour of the end, an end at :40-:49 37 %, at :50-:59 18 %).  v18e: the co-organiser announced the day before that the programme runs to 22:20 (attendance about 20,000 by its own report); probability of the 21:30 end lowered from 0.6 to 0.25.

extras.name: 가재울 둘째 토요일 오전 급증 (원인 미확인, 2026-03~06 네 달 연속)

scenarios.note: the monthly gathering takes place again

extras.basis: Training data: on the second Saturday of March, April, May and June 2026 the 12h boardings were 791 / 1,192 / 932 / 1,105 (other Saturdays of those months: 208) and the 11h boardings 225 / 406 / 373 / 528 (219); nothing of the kind on any second Saturday before March 2026.  The cause is not identified and nobody could confirm that it continued, so the entry is the probability-weighted mean in log space (p = probability that it took place; lower in August and on the long weekend of 10 October).

extras.name: 제14회 연수 능허대 문화축제, 연수한마음공원 (금·한글날, 21:00 종료)
extras.basis: Bus boardings 299 / 213 / 941 / 325 at 19 / 20 / 21 / 22h: a crowd four times the spring festival, leaving at the official end 21:00.  Bus boardings at the two stops 선학역 (ARS 38305, 38306), summed, against ordinary levels of about 110 / 75 / 65 / 80 at 19 / 20 / 21 / 22h.  At the spring festival of the same park (2026-03-28/29, training period) an excess of 310 and 180 bus boardings at 20-21h went with 1,060 and 975 subway boardings above normal, i.e. 3.4-5.4 subway per bus boarding; the three scenarios use 3, 4 and 5.  The later hour is reduced by 0.3 for the lag of bus taps.

extras.name: 2026 인천송도국제마라톤 (08:00 출발, 인천대 송도캠퍼스)
extras.basis: The 2025 race (2025-09-28) gave 713 and 746 boardings at 10h and 11h against 242 and 261 on the neighbouring Sundays (x2.9). The retrained model of v14 already raises these two hours by about 30 %; x1.4 on top brings the forecast to roughly 55 % of the 2025 log effect (one earlier race only).

summer_leave.name: 여름 집단휴가 2주 (평일 7/27~8/7)
summer_leave.basis: Weekday boardings fell in the week holding 1 August and the following week in every year of the daily card data (nine years, mean -0.09 and -0.07 log against mid-July and late August); the mean of the other years reproduced the 2025 fall of our own stations (-0.100 vs -0.107, -0.076 vs -0.075). Per station and hour group, half of the difference between the 2025 fall and the fall the forecast already holds is applied, only where 2025 was deeper. Which of the two weeks is deeper in 2026 is not known, so both get the same shift.

not_applied.name: 서울세계불꽃축제 2026-09-05 (여의도)
not_applied.reason: On the day of the 2025 edition (2025-09-27, Saturday) the night hours 20-23 at 계양 3110, 검암 3207 and 부평 3120 were 0.9-1.6 times an ordinary Saturday with no return wave at 22-23h at 계양 (0.93 at 22h); 부평 was raised through the whole afternoon and the median station was 1.04. One day, mixed with other events of that Saturday: not applied.
